name: io [Christmas Eve]
source:
One man. One woman. One little girl. And in their midst, a lot of the second movement of Beethoven's 8th piano sonata.

[From [url=http://altogether.insani.org/2005/resources/index/phase02-io.html]Zalas[/url]]
translation:
一个男人。一个女人。一个小女孩。而萦绕在三人之间的，是反复响起的贝多芬第八钢琴奏鸣曲第二乐章。

[摘自[url=http://altogether.insani.org/2005/resources/index/phase02-io.html]Zalas[/url]]
